remarks: Incredible opportunity to own this stunning, impeccably maintained FOUR-BEDROOM, TWO-FULL-BATH brick home on a quiet, centrally located street just minutes from virtually anywhere in WNY! The welcoming foyer opens to a thoughtfully designed floor plan filled with character. The warm, inviting living room showcases a gorgeous plaster ceiling w/ recessed center panel & intricate decorative moldings. Brand-new wall-to-wall carpeting over original hardwood floors adds warmth throughout the 1st floor. Flooded w/ natural light from a gorgeous bay window, the completely remodeled kitchen features hardwood floors, SS appliances, ample counter space & a two-tiered breakfast bar, seamlessly flowing into the formal dining room—perfect for everyday living & entertaining. Both 1st-floor bedrooms are generously sized, w/ one offering direct access to the incredible, fully fenced backyard & spectacular deck. The 1st-floor full bath features ceramic tile, linen closet, fresh paint & updated fixtures. Upstairs, the primary bedroom boasts a walk-in closet & private full-bath ensuite w/ granite-topped vanity & tub/shower combo w/ ceramic tile surround. The architecturally distinctive 4th bedroom features charming angled ceilings & a cozy, tucked-away feel. The bright, bone-dry full basement offers abundant additional space & houses solid mechanics, including forced-air furnace w/ Central A/C & sump pump w/ backup system. An oversized garage/barn w/ electric garage door & walk-up loft offers exceptional storage & versatility. Enjoy summer gatherings in the expansive, fully fenced backyard or unwind on a crisp autumn evening beneath the comfort of your covered front porch. Buy w/ confidence! This move-in-ready gem has been lovingly cared for & features a tear-off roof (2021). Conveniently located near Thruway access for an easy commute throughout WNY—this one has been waiting for you! OPEN HOUSE Sunday, 10/18, 1–3 PM! Sellers will begin listening to Offers at 1PM on Tuesday, 10/20/26.
